note: Measured gate-lane wall clock on successful CI. Read by tools/gate-duration.mjs; CI fails when a lane exceeds the committed baseline by more than maxFactor. Re-measure before changing a baseline; do not hand-edit a number just to make CI green.

batch.evidence: Projected from per-gate timestamps in green PR #362 run 36561761799 after moving blood (1069s) and fire-rate (871s) out of batch; remaining gates total about 4m20s of execution, with a 7m lane baseline for runner overhead/variance (#333).

blood.evidence: Isolated blood lane on PR #364 run 36772609542: 49.6 min (~2976s) with the post-#341 1,024-pair blood gate passing by 3.8 SE. #341 deliberately doubled the prior 512-pair sample; current main had already measured the same 1,024-pair gate at 49.9 and 53.3 min when blood shared the endings runner. A 50m isolated baseline therefore reflects the repeated 1,024-pair evidence rather than the stale 26m / 512-pair calibration; 1.25x guard = 62.5m (#333/#341).

fire-rate.evidence: Isolated fire-rate lane on PR #364 run 36586278258: 20.7 min (1240s) with fire-rate, outcome-reach and vocabulary-reach all passing. Baseline rounded to 21m; 1.25x guard = 26.25m, so runner noise is not treated as a regression (#333).

war.evidence: Isolated war lane on PR #364 run 36586278258: 38.7 min (2323s), with the war gate itself passing. The issue's successful-run evidence spans 21-39 min; baseline rounded to 39m; 1.25x guard = 48.75m (#333).

endings.evidence: PR #365 check run 36966981175 after #344 raised ENDING_DEFAULT_BATCH from 100 to 160: the endings gate passed at 160 paired chronicler/ascendant runs and completed in 8.6m. The previous 6m baseline described the 100-run lane. Baseline rounded to 9m; 1.25x guard = 11.25m, preserving the runtime-regression check while accounting for the deliberate 60% sample increase (#344).
